data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Vitamins & trace elements_

**Class:** Trace element (oral copper salts; copper peptides topically)

## Mechanism of action
- Cofactor of tyrosinase (melanin), lysyl oxidase (collagen and elastin cross-linking), cytochrome oxidase, superoxide dismutase

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Copper deficiency (malnutrition, high-dose zinc, bariatric surgery): hypopigmentation of skin and hair, anaemia, neutropenia, neuropathy
- Menkes kinky hair disease (copper histidinate injections — early)
- Topical copper peptides (GHK-Cu): wound healing, cosmeceuticals

## Dose & formulations
- Oral copper 2–4 mg/day elemental for deficiency (specialist guidance)

## Adverse effects
- Excess: GI upset, hepatic toxicity; Wilson disease (copper accumulation — Kayser–Fleischer rings, azure lunulae)

## Contraindications
- Wilson disease

## Drug interactions
- Zinc reduces copper absorption (used therapeutically in Wilson disease)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Dietary amounts safe.

## Viva points
- Menkes disease — pili torti, hypopigmentation; Wilson disease — azure lunulae
- Long-term zinc causes copper deficiency

_Sources: Khopkar (Trace elements — copper; copper peptides). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
